rationale: Stroud 10K confirmed (25 Oct), so race week goes in now. Changes: the provisional 24 Oct 2x2-mile session is removed and becomes a shakeout; 25 Oct becomes the 10K race (~16km all in); 21 Oct keeps 6x600m as the last sharpener, with the heavy-leg cut-off moved to that day. Why: nothing hard inside ~3 days of a race, and a fresh 10K is the best evidence the predictor gets for Manchester. Weeks 1-2 (to 18 Oct) are untouched - the Guy Fawkes-shaped threshold and 5-mile-pace work (2x15 on 17 Oct, 5x1km on 14 Oct) also suit a 10K, so nothing there needs to change. All of this is provisional until next Sunday, when the course profile should be known and the pacing written.

changes.notes: Provisional — Rest. Race week opens with the normal Monday.

Provisional — Last sharpener, 4 days before Stroud: 3km warm-up, 6x600m at 3:32-3:36/km with 2 min jog, 3km cool-down, ~11.5km all in. Purpose: speed just above 10K pace (~3:44/km projected on a flat course) so race effort feels controlled. Energy system: VO2/neuromuscular, short reps keep the cost low. Recovery cost ~1.5 days. Run on pace, not under. Last heavy leg session of the block is this week - nothing heavy in the gym after Wed 21 Oct. If HRV is still sliding by now, shorten to 4 reps rather than skip.
Provisional — Easy 7km. No heavy leg work from today.

Provisional — Shakeout 30-35 min, easy, no strides. The 2x2 miles that sat here is removed: nothing hard inside ~3 days of the race. Check Puma Fast-R Nitro 3 and kit; Symbicort/salbutamol timings ready for the morning.

Provisional — STROUD 10K - the October target. ~16km all in: 3km warm-up with strides, 10K, 3km cool-down. Projection 37:20 flat (3:44/km, band 36:19-38:20), but Stroud is hilly and the course profile is NOT yet known: get the route and elevation (clubmate's file) before the pacing is written in race week. Run by effort over the climbs, not forced even splits; on Sharpness 4 the lesson was to go out a few seconds slower than the downhill offers. Symbicort 20 min, salbutamol 15 min before gun. Puma Fast-R Nitro 3. Nothing new on the day.
